name.ja: Bトレインショーティー 485系・国鉄特急色
name.en: B Train Shorty 485 series/JNR limited express color

description.ja: • 東北本線・常磐線・羽越本線・北陸本線・鹿児島本線をはじめ全国各地で活躍した485系特急形交直流電車の後期タイプ。1972年に登場。
description.en: • A late type of the 485 series limited express AC/DC train that was used all over the country, including the Tohoku Main Line, Joban Line, Uetsu Main Line, Hokuriku Main Line, and Kagoshima Main Line. Appeared in 1972.

description.ja: • 先頭車の正面パーツは貫通式の200番台と非貫通式の300番台が付属。
description.en: • The front part of the lead car comes with the 200 series with a penetrating type and the 300 series with a non-penetrating type.

description.ja: • 中間車はパンタグラフつきとパンタグラフなしのいずれかを選択できる。
description.en: • You can choose between a pantograph and no pantograph for the intermediate car.
